blocks.title: Integrated Development Environment (IDE)
blocks.text: IDE ek jame software suite hai jo software development ke tamam zaroori tools ek jagah deta hai. Yeh editors, compilers, debuggers aur version control jaise tools ko ek mutahhid interface mein jorta hai jahan developers code kaarkardagi se likh, test aur debug kar sakte hain.

items: Eclipse: Java development ke liye aam.
Visual Studio: .NET aur C++ development ke liye mashhoor.
PyCharm: Python development ke liye pasandeeda.

blocks.prompt: Developers alag tools ki bajaye IDE kyun pasand karte hain?
blocks.explanation: IDE editor, compiler, debugger aur version control ek interface mein rakhta hai, to code likhna, chalana, test aur debug karna tez aur hamwar hota hai.

items: IDE: tamam development tools ek jagah (editor, compiler, debugger, version control); Eclipse, Visual Studio, PyCharm.
